title: From payment event to books and assurance
shared: These studies follow an authorized event through payment, operational records, accounting and assurance. Read them together to identify the handoffs and the different authorities, judgments and evidence requirements.
keep_distinct: Keep technical atomic execution, legal discharge, accounting recognition and measurement, double-entry books, attestations, auditor judgment and remedies separate. Visibility to an operator is not public transparency.
